reference: 21 other default-expression models whose OncotreePrimaryDisease contains Mesothelioma; no Y-status filtering
transform: TPM = 2**released_log2_TPMp1 - 1; ratios use unlogged TPM and reference median
selection: 15 canonical PAR1 protein-coding genes; XG excluded because it crosses the PAR boundary; no PAR2 genes
statistics: Descriptive comparisons only; no differential-expression test or causal inference
gene_origin: Released gene expression does not resolve X versus Y contribution to PAR transcripts
